lines.text: Jess starts up in sunshine, in trail runners.
Two thousand feet higher, the path is buried in snow and her shoes are soaked.
In November, conditions can change as you climb.
Here's the fix. Call the ranger station or check the trail report
for the upper miles, not just the trailhead.
Pack warm layers, and agree on a turnaround if you hit snow.
Next time, Jess turns at the snow line, dry.
Save this before your next climb.
